'''Luna''' is a map with plenty of verticality. Significance with item placements is the sparse number of cell packs, which is a total of 12 cells. Also the low amount of health packs (155, compared to the more usual 200+, like Aerowalk) intended to make it a bit more difficult to maintain control and re-heal instantly. Another key with map layout is the large open window where falling out causes instant death, similar to '''Skull'''.

Locs made by {{player|Flintheart|flag=se}}
